concept_gloss.applicability: Güzel bir iş yapma çekirdeğini, alıcıyı borçlu hissettiren ağırlığı ve insanın sözlü başa kakmasını birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: İyilik yapma, yük altında bırakma ve sözle başa kakma yönlerinin tümünü korur.

concept_gloss.text: iyilik yapma ve bunu yük ya da başa kakma haline getirme

concept_map.definition: Birine güzel bir iş yaparak iyilikte bulunma veya bir şey verme. Bu iyilik, karşıdakini yük altında bırakacak ölçüde ağırlaştırılabilir ya da insan tarafından sözle başa kakılabilir; Tanrı'ya bağlanan kullanım ise iyiliği eylemle sunmayı anlatır.

facets.statement: Birine güzel bir iş yapma, iyilikte bulunma veya bir şey verme.
Yapılan iyilik, alıcısını ağır bir yük ve borçluluk duygusu altında bırakabilir.
İnsanın yaptığı iyiliği sözle hatırlatıp başa kakması, güzel işi değersizleştiren bir davranış sayılır.
Tanrı'ya bağlanan kullanım, sözle hatırlatmayı değil, iyiliği eylemle bağışlamayı belirtir.
Bir buyrukta aynı ifade, eldeki şeyi verme veya harcama anlamına gelir.
Bir yasak ifadesi, verilen şeyi başa kakmama veya daha çoğunu elde etmek için vermeme biçimlerinde açıklanır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Güzel bir iş yapma veya birine karşılıksız yarar sağlama çekirdeğinin öne çıktığı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.loses: İyiliğin ağır bir yük olması, başa kakılması ve özel verme buyruklarını kapsamaz.
error_profile.preserves: Birine güzel bir iş yapma ve yarar sağlama çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanın verdiğini veya yaptığı iyiliği sözle hatırlatıp karşıdakini incittiği bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Başa kakılmayan iyilik yapma, eylemle bağışlama ve doğrudan verme kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: İyiliği sözle hatırlatma ve güzel işi değersizleştirme yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eldeki bir şey üzerinde serbestçe verme ya da harcama buyruğunun bulunduğu bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.loses: İyiliğin ağırlığını, başa kakmayı ve daha çok karşılık beklememe sınırını tek başına anlatmaz.
error_profile.preserves: Verme eylemini ve eldeki şeyi başkasına aktarma yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yasak içinde, verilen şey aracılığıyla daha büyük bir karşılık elde etmeye çalışmama açıklamasında kullanılır.

error_profile.collision: Açıklama yalnızca yasak ifadesinin bir yorumuna aittir; bütün dalın tek anlamı sanılmamalıdır.
error_profile.loses: Güzel iş yapma, alıcıyı yük altında bırakma ve sözle başa kakma kapsamının geri kalanını dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: Verme eylemini ve daha büyük karşılık beklentisi sınırını korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği iyilik yapmadır; yük altında bırakma ve başa kakma bunun her kullanımda zorunlu olmayan insan odaklı yönleridir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca yapılan iyiliği başa kakmayı değil, güzel bir iş yapmayı, birine iyilik etmeyi ve vermeyi de kapsar. Olumsuz yük, insanın yaptığı iyiliği sözle hatırlatması veya iyiliği karşıdakine ağırlık haline getirmesiyle belirginleşir; Tanrı'nın iyiliği ise sözle başa kakma değil, eylemle bağışlama olarak ayrılır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: birine iyilik etmek veya yaptığı iyilikle onu yük altında bırakmak
verdiğini başa kakma ya da daha çoğunu bekleyerek verme

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın iyilik yapma çekirdeğini, sözle başa kakmayı, eylemle bağışlamayı ve belirli verme buyruklarını birbirine karıştırmadan ayrı yüzler olarak sunar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Yayımlanan ilişkiler iyilik, bağış, başa kakma ve teşekkür senaryosundaki başlıca karışmaları kapsar; kalan adaylar karşı davranışları veya daha uzak eşsesli dalları gösterdiğinden sınırı daha fazla keskinleştirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal iyilik yapan ile alıcı arasındaki yük ve başa kakma ilişkisini de işler; komşu dal güzel davranışın ve çabanın kendisine odaklanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi ona zarar verecek başka bir şeyden korumak için araya bir araç ya da engel koyma ve böylece zararı ondan uzak tutma. Bu işlevi gören araç veya engel de aynı kavram alanında adlandırılır.

facets.statement: Korunan şeyden zarar verici etkiyi uzak tutma ve onu incinmekten ya da bozulmaktan saklama işlemidir.
Koruma, zarar ile korunacak şey arasına başka bir araç, katman veya engel koyularak gerçekleştirilir.
Kadının saçı ile dış örtüsü arasına koyduğu bez, bu koruyucu ara katmanın özel bir örneğidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi ona zarar verecek başka bir şeyden korumayı ve bunun için araya koruyucu bir unsur koymayı ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Koruyucu bez örneği bu genel işlemin özel bir gerçekleşmesidir ve dalın kimliğini değiştirmez.

facets.statement: Kişi, korkulan ya da zarar verecek şey ile kendi arasına koruyucu bir önlem koyar.
Öz-koruma, kişiyi suç doğuran ve yanlış sayılan davranışlardan uzak tutma biçimini alabilir.
Tanrı'ya karşı gelmekten sakınma, kişi ile sakınılan sonuç arasına koruyucu bir tutum koymak olarak düşünülür.

concept_gloss.text: hafif topallama ve toynak ağrısıyla yürümekten çekinme

concept_map.definition: Hafif topallama ile, özellikle toynak ağrısı veya hassasiyeti yüzünden yürümekten çekinen ya da sert zeminde ayağını sakınan atın durumu. Aynı kullanım kümesi, hayvanın aksamasına göre davranmayı, sert zeminden yakınmamayı ve hayvanda yara açmayan eyeri de anlatır.

facets.statement: Tek sözcüklü temel anlam, hayvanın yürüyüşündeki hafif topallamadır.
At, topalladığı veya toynağındaki ağrı yüzünden yürümekten çekindiği ve sert zeminde ayağını sakındığı için bu nitelemeyi alır.
Hayvana yönelik emir kalıbı, onun aksayışını gözeterek yürümeyi sürdürme ve kendini zorlamama anlamı taşır.
Eyer için kullanıldığında hayvanın sırtını yaralamayan veya berelenmesine yol açmayan eyer anlatılır.
Sert ve engebeli zeminle kurulan olumsuz emir, arazinin güçlüğünden yakınmama anlamına gelir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tek sözcüklü durum adı, neden veya hayvanın türü ayrıca belirtilmeden kullanıldığında uygundur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek hafif topallama ve ağrılı ya da hassas toynak yüzünden sakınarak yürümedir; eyer, emir ve sert zemin kullanımları bağımlı yan kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca toynak ağrısından kaçınmayı değil, hafif topallamayı, topallayan atın davranışını, hayvanda yara açmayan eyeri ve aksayışa göre davranma sözünü birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, fakat geçici hayvanın kendini koruması çerçevesi bütün malzemeyi taşıyacak biçimde aksama ve ona bağlı kullanımlar olarak yeniden kurulmalıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi hafif topallamayı çekirdek yapar ve bunu topallayan, toynak ağrısı yüzünden yürümekten çekinen ya da sert zeminde ayağını sakınan atla açımlar. Aksamaya göre davranma, sert zeminden yakınmama ve yara açmayan eyer kullanımları aynı kümede yer alan fakat çekirdeğe bağımlı yan kullanımlardır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ölçü ailesinin iki bağlama göre değişen değerini tek açıklayıcı karşılıkta birlikte göstermenin gerektiği yerlerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ağırlık ölçüsü olmasını, para hesabındaki kırk sayısını ve yağ hesabındaki yedi birimlik değişkeyi korur.

concept_gloss.text: kırk gümüş para ağırlığındaki, yağda yedi birimlik biçimi bulunan ölçü

concept_map.definition: Bir kullanımda kırk gümüş paranın ağırlığına, başındaki ses düşmüş başka bir biçim ve kullanımda ise yağ için yedi temel ağırlık birimine eşit kabul edilen ölçü. İlk biçim daha düzgün sayılır ve birden çok çoğul biçimi vardır.

facets.statement: Temel biçim, belirli bir ağırlık ölçüsüdür ve para hesabında kırk gümüş paranın ağırlığına eşitlenir.
Başındaki ses düşmüş biçim, yağ ölçümünde kullanılan ve yedi temel ağırlık birimine eşit sayılan ayrı bir değeri bildirir.
Başlangıç sesini koruyan biçim daha düzgün kabul edilir ve ölçü adının iki çoğul söylenişi kaydedilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Para ağırlığının esas alındığı ilk biçim ve kullanım kastedildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ölçünün ağırlık niteliğini ve kırk gümüş para ağırlığına eşit değerini korur.

contextual_glosses.text: kırk gümüş para ağırlığına denk ölçü

contextual_glosses.applicability: Başındaki ses düşmüş biçimin yağ ölçümündeki özel değeri açıklanırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yağ bağlamını, ağırlık ölçüsü olmasını ve yedi temel birime eşit değeri korur.

contextual_glosses.text: yağ için yedi temel birimlik ağırlık ölçüsü

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ölçü adının birden fazla çoğul söylenişi bulunduğu açıklanırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Söz konusu biçimlerin aynı ağırlık ölçüsü adının çoğulları olmasını korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca bu adlandırılmış ağırlık ölçüsü ve onun biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; genel tartma eylemine, her türlü miktara veya modern bir ölçü adına genişletilmez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı bilinen bir ağırlık ölçüsü olarak doğrular, ancak tek ve değişmez bir nicelik vermez. Bir kullanım kırk gümüş para ağırlığını, başındaki ses düşmüş başka bir biçim ise yağ için yedi temel ağırlık birimini gösterir; tanım bu bağlam farkını açıkça korumalıdır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kırk gümüş para ağırlığına eşit bilinen ölçü

bu ağırlık ölçüsü adının çoğul biçimleri

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, iki sözcük biçimine bağlı farklı ölçü değerlerini ve çoğul biçimleri ayırır; bunlardan genel bir kök anlamı çıkarmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; yayımlananlar genel ağırlık, küçük para ölçüsü, başka geleneksel birim, hacim-miktar ölçüsü ve ayar standardı sınırlarını gösterir. Artış ve çok büyük tahıl ölçüsü daha uzaktır; öteki kök içi dallar anlamsal olarak ayrıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal değerleri ve sözcük biçimleri belirlenmiş tek bir geleneksel ölçüyü adlandırır; komşu dal ağırlık ve tartma alanının genel kavramıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bağlama göre kırk gümüş para veya yedi temel birim değerini taşıyan belirli bir ölçü adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: özel ağırlık ölçüsü ile genel tartma
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ağırlık, tartı aracı ve bir şeye ağırlığını verme gibi genel ölçme alanını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal belirlenmiş ağırlık ve ölçme düşüncesinde buluşur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ölçülerin adları ve değerleri ayrıdır: bu dal kırk paralık değeri ve yağdaki değişkeyi taşırken komşu dal çoğunlukla beş paralık küçük miktarı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Para hesabında kırk gümüş para ağırlığına veya yağda yedi birime bağlanan ölçüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kırk paralık ölçü ile beş paralık ölçü
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Altın veya gümüş için kullanılan, çoğunlukla beş gümüş para ağırlığıyla açıklanan daha küçük ölçüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da değerli maden veya para üzerinden açıklanan geleneksel ağırlık ölçüleridir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın ölçü adı ve verilen değerleri kendine özgüdür; komşu dal başka birim adını ve ağırlığın yanında hacim kullanımını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İki sözcük biçimi ve iki bağlamsal değeri bulunan belirli bir ağırlık ölçüsüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Başka bir adla anılan, hem ağırlık hem hacim ölçüsü olabilen ayrı bir geleneksel birimdir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal belirli adları, tekil ve çoğul biçimleri bulunan geleneksel ölçü birimleridir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal ağırlığa ve belirli değerlere bağlıdır; komşu dal hacim ile para miktarı arasında daha geniş bir ölçüm alanına yayılır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Öncelikle ağırlık ölçüsüdür ve iki özel sayısal değere bağlanır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: ağırlık ölçüsü ile hacim ve miktar ölçüsü
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hacim ölçüsünü, yarım başka bir hacim ölçüsünü ve para miktarını birlikte kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da sayılabilir veya ölçülebilir bir miktarı geleneksel birimle belirtir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal ölçülen miktarı bildiren birimdir; komşu dal ise ölçü araçlarının ve paraların doğruluğunu belirleyen ayar standardıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kendi adı, biçimleri ve geleneksel değerleri bulunan ölçü birimini tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ölçekleri ve paraları denetlemeye yarayan ayarı veya ölçünleme işlemini tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal doğru ağırlık ve ölçü değerinin belirlenmesi alanındadır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kuş türünün Türkçedeki doğal adı olarak dalın adlandırma çekirdeğini doğrudan karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kaynakta adlandırılan kuş türünün kimliğini herhangi bir ek anlam yüklemeden korur.

concept_map.definition: Örümcek kuşunun, biri son sesi koruyan diğeri bu sesi düşüren iki biçimde söylenen adı. Adlandırma, kuşun yürürken adımlarını fazla açmamasıyla açıklanır.

facets.statement: Sözcük, örümcek kuşunu adlandıran özel bir kuş adıdır.
Kuş adı, son sesi bulunan daha uzun ve bu sesin düştüğü daha kısa iki biçimde kullanılır.
Adın kuşa verilmesi, yürürken adımlarını fazla açmayan kısa adımlı yürüyüşüyle açıklanır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuş adının yürüyüş biçimiyle ilişkilendirilen açıklaması da bağlamda görünür kılınmak istendiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kuş türünü ve adlandırmaya gerekçe gösterilen kısa adımlı yürüyüş özelliğini birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca örümcek kuşunun bu iki adına ve adlandırma açıklamasına aittir; koruyan kişi, topallayan at veya yara açmayan eyer anlamlarına geçmez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı doğrudan örümcek kuşunun adı olarak verir, adın son sesi bulunan ve düşmüş iki biçimini kaydeder ve adlandırmayı kuşun yürürken adımlarını fazla açmamasına bağlar. Geçici çerçeve bu sınırı doğru biçimde yansıtır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: örümcek kuşu; aynı kuş adının uzun ve kısalmış biçimleri

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kuşa verilmiş iki özel ad biçimiyle sınırlı tutulur ve bunlardan genel bir koruma ya da yürüme anlamı türetilmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yayımlanan dört karşılaştırma kuş adları arasındaki tür ayrımını yeterince gösterir. Öteki kuş adayları da yalnızca aynı alanı paylaşır; kurt adı ile koruma, ağırlık ve hayvan yürüyüşü dalları farklı kimliklerdir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortaklık yalnızca kuş adı olmalarıdır; bu dal örümcek kuşunu, komşu dal ise ibibiği adlandırır ve türler birbirinin yerine geçmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kısa adımlı yürüyüşüyle açıklanan örümcek kuşu adı merkezde yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tarla kuşunu ve ona ait farklı ad biçimlerini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da küçük kuş türlerine verilmiş adları ve bu adların biçimlerini ele alır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın göndergesi örümcek kuşudur; komşu dal başka bir küçük kuş türünü adlandırır ve ortak kuş alanı tür özdeşliği oluşturmaz.

root_profile.summary: Kökün merkezinde, zarar ile korunacak taraf arasına koruyucu bir unsur koyma fikri vardır; bu fikir kişinin kendisini korkulan veya yanlış davranıştan sakınmasına ve hayvanın ağrılı adımını gözeten bazı kullanımlara uzanır. Belirli ağırlık ölçüsü ile örümcek kuşu adı ise bu koruma çekirdeğinden ayrışmış adlandırma dallarıdır.

text.arabic_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ يُوسُفُ ۖ قَالَ أَنَا۠ يُوسُفُ وَهَٰذَآ أَخِى ۖ قَدْ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَتَّقِ وَيَصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

baseline.text: Onlar, "Yoksa sen gerçekten Yusuf musun?" dediler. O, "Ben Yusuf'um, bu da kardeşim. Allah bize iyilikte bulundu. Kim Allah'a karşı gelmekten sakınır ve sabrederse Allah iyilik yapanların ödülünü boşa çıkarmaz" dedi.

findings.text: Geçmişte tanınmayan iktidar sahibi, önceki eylemleri hatırlatan soruyla yeniden adı konmuş kardeşe dönüşür; ahlaki hatırlama görsel tanımanın tamamlayamadığı izi sağlar.
Allah'ın iyiliği, Yusuf'un sahip olduğu üstünlük değil, iki kardeşi koruyucu sakınma ve sabır boyunca kaybolmayan sonuca taşıyan ağır bir bağıştır.

activation_trace.role: Conjectural force in interrogative saying keeps the first identification provisional.
Audible utterance converts the hypothesis into public self-naming through the answer.
Literal kinship makes the disclosure relational rather than a recovery of a proper name alone.

changed_reading.after: Recognition is staged as movement from voiced conjecture to voiced self-naming, with brotherhood restoring the disclosed identity to a relationship.
changed_reading.before: The exchange simply confirms that the official is Joseph and identifies the man beside him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired acts of saying and the deictic identification of a brother.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first speech act holds identity as an interrogative hypothesis; the reply makes that identity public and immediately places it inside a kin relation.

activation_trace.role: Putting oneself within protection supplies the active self-guarding at the condition's first stage.
Restraint from panic supplies persistence through the condition's second stage.
Disappearance or forfeiture names the outcome explicitly denied to sustained good.
Return for work gives the preserved consequence a labor-and-recompense structure.
Beneficent and well-made action extends the mechanism beyond private endurance into enacted good.

changed_reading.after: Protective self-discipline and sustained restraint form a causal practice that keeps beneficent action alive, while divine non-loss secures its consequence against disappearance.
changed_reading.before: Piety and patience receive a divine reward.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional sequence linking guarding, patience, divine non-loss, reward, and beneficent action.
baseline_models.mechanism: Guarding establishes a protective discipline, patience sustains it under pressure, and the denial of loss guarantees that this endurance can mature into effective good rather than mere survival.

activation_trace.role: Bestowal of benefaction supplies the direct sense of divine favor.
Release without compensation adds an unbought-liberation image to that favor.
The tether image turns brotherhood into a bond that can be fastened again.
Setting a break that healed crookedly contributes a cautious repair image to preserved reward.

changed_reading.after: A live secondary reading hears the favor as unpriced release that reties a damaged kin bond, with non-lost reward shading into repair rather than status alone.
changed_reading.before: God bestowed favor on Joseph and his brother.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Divine favor toward the two brothers followed by the assurance that reward is not lost.
baseline_models.mechanism: Favor can carry both benefaction and release without price; beside the restored brother-bond and the fracture-repair branch of reward, it permits a second reading in which grace liberates and rebinds rather than merely elevates.

activation_trace.role: Attribution of theft supplies the externally imposed account attached to Joseph's family.
Hiding something inwardly supplies the first movement of controlled concealment.
The mind's inward content locates the withheld response before it is voiced.
Appearance and emergence name the disclosure that is initially refused.
The paired spoken acts provide the eventual outward channel for recognition and avowal.

changed_reading.after: The answer culminates a longer discipline of disclosure: Joseph replaces a concealed, imposed account with a timed public avowal of identity.
changed_reading.before: The answer resolves a momentary failure to recognize Joseph.

context_deltas.mechanism: An imposed theft-story is attributed, held inside Joseph, and explicitly not displayed; the focus exchange reverses that sequence by letting him author and voice his own identity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies imposed attribution, inward concealment, non-display, and later paired speech; I infer a reversal from others' story to self-authored disclosure. A live alternative is that the earlier concealment is only tactical and does not govern the later naming.
structural_cues: 12:77 embeds a judgment inside Joseph and negates its disclosure; 12:90 is organized as an audible question-answer pair.

activation_trace.role: Strength after humiliation gives the official title a latent reversal trajectory beneath the unrecognized identity.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies genuine moral perception despite failed personal recognition.
Beneficent action names the quality they recognize before they know the actor.
The focus maxim repeats beneficent action as the class whose consequence is preserved.
Spoken self-identification finally aligns the previously seen quality with Joseph.

changed_reading.after: His maxim retroactively confirms that the brothers had already recognized his ihsan while failing to recognize him, separating moral sight from facial or social recognition.
changed_reading.before: Joseph identifies himself and then states a general maxim about excellent people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brothers had already perceived the unidentified powerful official as a beneficent actor; the focus self-naming makes their earlier ethical recognition precede and survive their failure of personal recognition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earlier judgment that the official is among beneficent actors and a later maxim about those same actors; I infer a deliberate recognition loop. The maxim may alternatively remain wholly general and not echo their prior assessment.
structural_cues: The earlier address and moral assessment occur under an official title; the proper identity is spoken only in 12:90.

activation_trace.role: Custody and capture expose the coercive force inside the request to take one person in another's place.
The refusal restricts detention rather than allowing a substitute body to satisfy the claim.
Putting something in the wrong place makes substitution a concrete image of injustice.
Release without compensation supplies a non-exchange reading of divine favor.
Actual kinship replaces the attempted interchangeability of persons with a named relation.

changed_reading.after: The favor can also mark liberation from a substitution-and-custody economy: the brothers appear together as persons in a restored relation, not exchangeable bodies.
changed_reading.before: Divine favor rescued Joseph and his brother from hardship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding negotiation tries to place one body in another's custody and is refused as wrongful displacement; the focus favor-as-release branch consequently reads as an end to substitutionary detention and exchange.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies substitution, custody, wrongful placement, and a focus branch of gratuitous release; I infer that favor terminates an exchange logic in which persons stand in for one another. The release branch may instead be only a remote lexical resonance.
structural_cues: The request to take one brother in another's place is followed by refusal, continued detention, and finally the joint self-identification of Joseph and his brother.

activation_trace.role: A confirmed covenant supplies the relational obligation against which later conduct is measured.
Neglect and wasting name the brothers' prior failure toward Joseph.
Negated departure supplies a corrective act of remaining in place under obligation.
Surety and continued attachment recast patience as fidelity to a person or charge.
Loss and forfeiture form the exact negative field that divine action reverses.
Recompense for work identifies what divine conservation carries through the failure.

changed_reading.after: The non-loss clause answers the story's human wasting: patient fidelity is the practice of not abandoning a bond, and divine action prevents that repaired good from sharing Joseph's earlier forfeiture.
changed_reading.before: God preserves the reward earned by patient righteous people.

context_deltas.mechanism: A confirmed covenant is followed by admitted neglect of Joseph and then by one brother's refusal to leave; the focus denial of divine wasting answers human forfeiture, while patience acquires the sense of staying bound to a charge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human neglect, covenant, corrective staying, and divine non-loss; I infer an anti-waste reversal in which patience repairs fidelity. The focus clause can alternatively be a broad maxim without answering the earlier neglect lexically or causally.
structural_cues: The sequence moves from covenant, through explicit prior neglect, to staying put; the focus then denies that God lets good consequence be lost.

activation_trace.role: Restraint from panic supplies the father's named mode of enduring separation.
Beauty in action qualifies patience by how it is carried, not only by duration.
Joining what was scattered supplies the explicit hoped-for outcome of that patience.
The repeated restraint carries the father's reunion horizon into Joseph's maxim.
The visible brother relation is the first local embodiment of scattered kin being joined.

changed_reading.after: Patience is transgenerational and centripetal: it preserves relation across dispersal until separated kin can be gathered again.
changed_reading.before: Joseph commends the same individual endurance that his father displayed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The father's beautiful patience is grammatically joined to hope that God will gather the dispersed family; when Joseph names himself and his brother before repeating patience, endurance becomes a reunion-producing relation rather than isolated stoicism.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the patience-gathering sequence and the later paired brothers; I infer that reunion is patience's narrative product. The two patience statements may alternatively characterize separate agents without a shared family mechanism.
structural_cues: In 12:83 patience is followed immediately by hope of total gathering; in 12:90 Joseph and his brother are named together before patience is restated.

activation_trace.role: The cutting off of hope supplies the explicitly prohibited failure mode.
Following traces of news turns continued hope into investigative movement.
Relief and rest provide the horizon toward which the search persists.
Active self-guarding keeps despair from closing the search.
Sustained restraint gives the search enough duration to reach recognition.

changed_reading.after: Patience includes hope-governed inquiry: guarding against despair keeps agents moving and sensing until recognition becomes possible.
changed_reading.before: Patience means waiting faithfully until God changes the situation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command not to sever hope is paired with tracking news by the senses and seeking relief; the focus recognition question can therefore be read as the perceptual yield of patient action, not passive waiting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies active search, anti-despair, and subsequent recognition; I infer that patient hope preserves perception until identity can be seen. A live alternative is that the brothers' commercial return, not their search, causes the encounter.
structural_cues: The command sequence is go, investigate, and do not despair; three ayat later the brothers formulate the recognition question.

activation_trace.role: A small, barely circulating asset supplies the scene's initial material deficit.
Completion without shortfall supplies the requested reversal of deficit.
Measured food gives the reversal a concrete accounting unit.
Charitable property or right converts measured exchange into benefaction.
Matching an act with its consequence links charity to divine recompense.
The denial of forfeiture closes the possibility of moral short measure.
Payment or return for action makes the moral-accounting link explicit.
Beneficent action identifies what enters this non-deficit account.

changed_reading.after: The clause becomes an anti-deficit guarantee: inadequate human means can meet full benefaction, and no unit of enacted good is short-measured in divine recompense.
changed_reading.before: God never overlooks the moral credit of those who do good.

context_deltas.mechanism: Meager goods are carried into a request for full measure and charity, followed by a statement of divine recompense; the focus non-loss of reward converts that commercial scene into an anti-deficit moral account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commercial measure, charity, recompense, and then non-lost reward; I infer that the material ledger models a moral economy of no shortfall. The terms may alternatively remain neighboring but independent economic and ethical statements.
structural_cues: The focus follows immediately after a material sequence of low tender, full measure, charity, and recompense.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower frames the preceding question as an epistemic opening.
An enacted deed makes what must be known moral and historical, not merely visual.
Absence of knowledge supplies the prior state reversed by recognition.
The interrogative saying gives their newly forming knowledge the shape of a hypothesis.
The answer stabilizes that hypothesis as public knowledge.

changed_reading.after: Recognition is an ethical change of knowing: once the deed done in ignorance becomes knowable, its obscured recipient can become recognizable.
changed_reading.before: The brothers infer Joseph's identity from a revealing reference to the past.

context_deltas.mechanism: Joseph first asks whether they know their own deed under ignorance; their next question recognizes the person to whom it was done. Moral knowledge thus opens personal recognition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent questions about deed-knowledge and identity; I infer that moral recollection causes recognition. The adjacency may instead mark Joseph's verbal hint as a purely cognitive clue.
structural_cues: The question about knowing their deed in 12:89 is answered narratively by their identity question and Joseph's answer in 12:90.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed benefaction supplies Joseph's non-comparative grammar of grace.
The named brother relation gives the initial us a concrete shared bond.
Preference by choice supplies the brothers' explicitly comparative interpretation.
Missing the right course identifies their acknowledged error inside that comparison.

changed_reading.after: Joseph first frames grace as shared restoration of the two harmed brothers; comparative chosenness is the brothers' next reading, and the text preserves the tension rather than collapsing them.
changed_reading.before: Joseph attributes his elevation over his brothers to God's favor.

context_deltas.mechanism: Joseph first speaks of favor upon an us, while the brothers immediately recode the event as God's preference of you over us and confess error; the sequence keeps shared restoration and comparative elevation as competing readings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shift from shared favor to comparative preference; I infer that Joseph's framing resists a zero-sum account before the brothers reintroduce it. The initial us may refer only to Joseph and his brother without intending any wider correction.
structural_cues: Joseph's favor-upon-us formulation directly precedes the brothers' preferred-you-over-us formulation.

activation_trace.role: Blame for wrongdoing supplies the sanction that Joseph explicitly declines.
Covering fault while protecting its bearer supplies the requested divine treatment of the wrongdoers.
Tender mercy supplies the affective action replacing reproach.
The kinship branch makes mercy structurally capable of restoring family relation.
Beneficent action supplies the category Joseph immediately performs toward those who harmed him.
Release without compensation anticipates the waiver of reproach.

changed_reading.after: He immediately turns preserved ihsan outward: its visible reward is the capacity to waive blame, seek protection for offenders, and reopen kinship.
changed_reading.before: Joseph explains his favorable outcome as the reward for his own conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus principle is followed immediately by refusal of blame, covering of fault, and mercy whose branch also names kinship; ihsan is therefore enacted as releasing wrongdoers and preserving relation, not merely claimed as reward due.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies maxim then merciful response; I infer that Joseph demonstrates the maxim rather than merely describing his own entitlement. The later response can alternatively be a separate act whose sequence does not define the maxim.
structural_cues: The maxim about preserved ihsan is followed in the next ayah by no reproach, a prayer for forgiveness, and mercy.

remaining_uncertainties: The scope of the focus first-person plural may be limited to Joseph and his brother, so its resistance to the brothers' later comparison remains inferential.
The repeated beneficent-actor language may deliberately echo the brothers' earlier assessment or may be a general maxim.
The container, measured-weight, tether, and bone-setting branches are useful material activators but remain form-distant analogies.
Narrative adjacency supports the proposed causal arrows, but the packet does not state every arrow explicitly.
strongest_changes: The question-answer pair completes a reversal from concealed imposed attribution to timed, self-authored identity.
Divine non-loss answers human neglect and turns patience into covenantal fidelity that gathers rather than abandons.
The full-measure and charity sequence makes reward an anti-deficit moral economy, while the next response enacts ihsan as waived blame and kin mercy.
Recognition becomes ethical and epistemic: the brothers see beneficence before identity and recognize identity only after confronting the deed done in ignorance.
summary.what_was_special: Distinct mechanisms remain live together: public disclosure, unbought release, anti-waste fidelity, reunion, active search, full-measure recompense, noncompetitive grace, and kin mercy. Material readings of pressure, weight, and fracture were retained as explicitly qualified outliers rather than flattened into the main models.

activation_trace.role: A protective barrier supplies the boundary that keeps pressure from becoming damage.
The sides and upper boundary of a vessel provide the form-distant containment image.
Stopping an outlet after fullness supplies the danger of sealed emotional pressure.
Revealing what was held inside supplies a controlled outlet compatible with endurance.
Voiced speech is the eventual non-destructive release channel.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, patience is regulated containment: guarding supplies a boundary, while rightly directed speech releases pressure without surrendering ethical control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The container and stopped-outlet images are materially surprising and should not replace the ordinary sense of patience; they remain anchored in the focus patience and guarding roots and are sharpened by the sequence from held grief to disclosed inward content. Render this only as a pressure-regulation analogy: restraint governs the timing and destination of release rather than requiring permanent silence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacency of guarding and patience before the spoken assurance.

activation_trace.role: A measured weight lets favor acquire an exploratory quantitative image.
The little offered asset establishes the inadequate side of the countermeasure.
Fullness without deficit supplies the answering excess.
Measured food gives the analogy a concrete scale.
Recompense links the quantitative image back to the focus consequence.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, favor functions as God's countermeasure: meager human means are answered by fullness, and the ensuing reward is not allowed to register a deficit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The weight sense of favor is branch-distant and must not be offered as a lexical translation; it remains anchored in the focus favor root and is unusually activated by the immediately preceding little-goods, full-measure, and reward sequence. Render it as a material analogy in which grace supplies a countermeasure to human insufficiency.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Divine favor followed by non-lost recompense.

activation_trace.role: Setting a break healed on an angle supplies the central repair analogy.
The tether image makes the named brother bond the first joint being reset.
Kinship within mercy supplies the tissue of relational repair.
Making two endpoints meet provides a mechanical image of reunion.
Restored ocular seeing embodies repair as recovered perception.
Near affiliation expands repair from one brother bond to the household.
Joining the scattered supplies the repair's final family-scale motion.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, non-lost reward appears as the resetting of a long-misaligned fracture: brotherhood, perception, and household are brought back into relation.
changed_reading.before: The reward is a benefit preserved for an excellent individual.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The bone-setting branch of reward is strongly form-distant and should never be presented as the ordinary meaning of recompense; it remains focus-anchored and gains narrative traction when mercy reactivates kinship, endpoints are brought together, sight returns, and the household is gathered. Render it as a contained repair analogy for a family that had persisted in a crookedly healed state.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The non-loss of reward beside the newly reasserted brother bond.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Recognition converts hidden authority back into named brotherhood.** ء خ و B001 and the doubled self-identification reverse the asymmetry of 12:58. I infer that the prior question about what they did supplies the final trace by which the unrecognized ruler becomes Yusuf.
2. **Weighty favor is interpreted through protective caution and restraint.** م ن ن B003/B004 (weighty favor; free release), و ق ي B002, ص ب ر B001, ض ي ع B001, ء ج ر B001, and ح س ن B002 form Yusuf’s causal account. I infer that favor does not cancel endurance; it carries endured good action to a non-lost outcome.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:92 showed the favor’s ethical form in Yusuf’s refusal to reproach, not only in his survival and office.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Favor explained through guarded endurance, not possession.** `م ن ن:B003` is a weighty benefaction; `و ق ي:B002` is placing the self in protective caution. Joseph identifies God’s favor on both brothers, then states a general mechanism joining self-guarding and patience to reward that is not lost. The packet supplies reunion, prior shelter of the brother (12:69), Joseph’s restrained disclosure, and the conditional principle; I infer that favor names the enabling outcome of sustained moral protection, not superiority owned by Joseph. *Manna Allāhu ʿalaynā* reads as received benefaction with an articulated ethical path.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:101 reclassifies rule and interpretive knowledge as gifts before asking for a sound death and righteous affiliation, preventing the favor named here from terminating in worldly success.

words.gloss_range: completed plural speech: the brothers speak as a carried-forward group at the recognition moment
words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوا}} ({{tr:qālū}}) begins the ayah as a carried-forward group outburst: the unnamed plural subject makes the brothers recognizable from the prior scene, and the perfect verb lets their recognition-question land as one completed speech event. Because the same root returns in {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) at word 6, many astonished voices are set against Yusuf single composed answer. The Surah 12 speech network also reaches a reversal here, as the brothers public speech moves from accusation and denial into recognition, then into confession in 12:91.
words.root_gloss_range: saying, uttering, and reporting speech; locally a Form I plural perfect opening the recognition question

topics.headline: plural speech continuity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers are carried forward by verb morphology, so recognition begins as continuation of the brothers story rather than a new scene.
topics.reason: The verb is a Form I 3mp perfect with no named subject, and the local quotation frame identifies the brothers contextually.

topics.headline: public recognition utterance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears recognition become public speech before Yusuf answers it.
topics.reason: The speech verb opens a quoted question that names Yusuf, so the utterance performs the recognition it seeks to verify.

topics.headline: speech-root reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Surah 12 speech chain turn from earlier crisis speech into disclosure and confession.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah references and the local q-w-l reprise with word 6 supports the dialogue contrast.

words.gloss_range: interrogative plus inna with attached second-person suffix; question and assertion coexist
words.prose: {{ar:أَإِنَّكَ}} ({{tr:a-innaka}}) makes the brothers question almost assert what it doubts: the interrogative hamza takes the whole identity proposition, while {{tr:inna}} and the attached second-person suffix already press toward recognition. Accepted readings without the hamza can sound like direct recognition, while the canonical form keeps shock and confirmation-seeking together; the non-canonical disjunctive reading is useful only as contrast. The sharp initial catch suits the boundary from the knowledge-challenge of 12:89 into enacted recognition.

topics.headline: question loaded with assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers are not simply uncertain; their grammar already carries recognition while still asking for confirmation.
topics.reason: The word combines interrogative hamza, inna, and a 2ms suffix governing the identity clause.

topics.headline: question versus recognition reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how removing or altering the hamza changes the illocution, while the local canonical reading remains an incredulous question.
topics.reason: Accepted variant evidence is useful for contrast, and the shawadhdh disjunction cannot govern the local canonical parse.

words.gloss_range: emphatic lam fused to the following independent pronoun inside the identity question
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is the small particle that puts assertion inside the question: it fuses to the independent pronoun and makes the addressee emphatic before the name arrives. With the earlier hamza and {{tr:inna}}, it completes the recognition cluster, so the brothers ask while the grammar already leans hard toward certainty. Its place among the ayah repeated emphatics helps map three peaks: recognition, principle, and guarantee.

topics.headline: emphasis on the addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word does not merely decorate the clause; it intensifies the person being identified.
topics.reason: QAC treats the lam as grammatically bound to the following pronoun, and CRITICAL rows identify it as emphatic.

topics.headline: recognition cluster
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the lam as part of a multi-particle pressure system, not an isolated marker.
topics.reason: The lam completes the a-inna-la cluster and participates in the ayah wider emphatic architecture.

words.gloss_range: independent second-person pronoun foregrounding the addressee before the name
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْتَ}} ({{tr:anta}}) repeats and foregrounds the addressee already carried in {{ar:أَإِنَّكَ}} ({{tr:a-innaka}}). Whether read as separation or reinforcement, the independent pronoun makes the identity question land first on you yourself before the bare name appears, with no added descriptors needed. That direct address turns Yusuf from someone spoken about into the present person being confronted.

topics.headline: independent pronoun doubling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the emphatic doubling of the second person, with suffix and independent pronoun both pointing to the same addressee.
topics.reason: The inna suffix and the independent pronoun share the same referent inside the identity clause.

topics.headline: direct address before the name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the recognition pause on you before the name Yusuf completes it.
topics.reason: The pronoun is the subject before the proper-name predicate and forces direct address.

words.gloss_range: foreign proper name functioning as the predicate of the brothers identity question
words.prose: {{ar:يُوسُفُ}} ({{tr:Yūsufu}}) is the predicate of the brothers question, with no copula and no descriptive title needed; the name itself is the content they need confirmed. Its foreign proper-name and diptote shape remain grammatically visible, while the supplied addition/increase etymology is only a background pressure, sharpened by the final non-wasting promise rather than replacing the proper-name sense. The same name returns in Yusuf answer at word 8, moving from questioned identity to accepted self-naming.

topics.headline: name as identity predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the name alone completes the brothers recognition question.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a foreign proper noun and predicate of the identity question.

topics.headline: foreign proper name with addition residue
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the foreign-name and addition-increase residue in view without treating it as the local lexical sense.
topics.reason: The local word is a proper name; etymological pressure may color the ayah non-loss arc but cannot replace the name function.

topics.headline: question-to-answer name reprise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the name pass from the brothers question to Yusuf confirmation in the same ayah.
topics.reason: The repetition at word 8 and surah-local concentration support the disclosure payoff.

words.gloss_range: completed singular speech: Yusuf answers the plural question with a focused declaration
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) pivots from the brothers plural question into Yusuf singular answer. The omitted subject is resolved by {{ar:أَنَا يُوسُفُ}} ({{tr:anā Yūsufu}}), so the speech verb delays the full reveal for one beat and then lets the declaration enact disclosure. Its echo with word 1 frames the ayah as a complete question-answer exchange, while the move from private disclosure in 12:69 to public disclosure here gives the root a narrative arc that immediately sets up the brothers oath-confession in 12:91.
words.root_gloss_range: saying, uttering, and reporting speech; locally a Form I singular perfect that pivots from question to answer

topics.headline: singular answer to plural question

topics.reason: The verb is 3ms perfect and contrasts directly with the 3mp opening verb.

topics.headline: speech act of public disclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Yusuf answer not with a gesture but with speech that makes hidden identity public.
topics.reason: Rows link this speech act to 12:69, the next confession in 12:91, and the boundary resolution of the prior verse.

words.gloss_range: independent first-person pronoun beginning Yusuf self-disclosure
words.prose: {{ar:أَنَا}} ({{tr:anā}}) makes Yusuf own the answer in first person before the name arrives. The independent pronoun is not needed after {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}), so its presence gives the self-disclosure visible form: the brothers ask you Yusuf, and he answers I, Yusuf. Across the boundary from 12:89, the one apparently being discussed becomes the speaker himself.

topics.headline: first-person self-reveal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Yusuf does more than confirm; he speaks from the I-position and performs the reveal.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun is the subject of the nominal self-identification and is chosen over implicit reference.

words.gloss_range: proper name repeated as Yusuf own public self-identification
words.prose: {{ar:يُوسُفُ}} ({{tr:Yūsufu}}) repeats the very name the brothers have just spoken, but now as Yusuf own predicate. The answer is therefore more than yes: the name is reclaimed in public self-identification. The local echo moves the name from doubtful recognition at word 5 to affirmed identity at word 8, resolving the discourse role left hanging from 12:89.

topics.headline: name reclaimed as answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Yusuf accepts and revoices the name instead of giving a bare yes.
topics.reason: The second proper-name predicate completes the no-copula self-identification.

topics.headline: question-answer name echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the name itself perform the disclosure by moving from their question to his answer.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that joins self-disclosure to brother-disclosure
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) refuses to let Yusuf self-naming stand alone: it coordinates {{ar:أَنَا يُوسُفُ}} ({{tr:anā Yūsufu}}) with {{ar:هَٰذَآ أَخِي}} ({{tr:hādhā akhī}}). The conjunction gives the brother-disclosure equal syntactic weight, so identity is restored relationally as well as personally. The short joined clauses also create a balanced cadence of two recognitions in one disclosure.

topics.headline: self and brother joined
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Yusuf disclosure immediately includes his brother instead of remaining solitary.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a conjunction joining the two nominal disclosure clauses.

words.gloss_range: proximal masculine demonstrative pointing to the brother present in the scene
words.prose: {{ar:هَٰذَآ}} ({{tr:hādhā}}) points to a present, singular person, making Benjamin visible inside the disclosure rather than merely remembered. The near demonstrative turns kinship into witnessed deixis: this one here is my brother. Structurally it pivots the utterance from Yusuf self-reveal to the restoration of his brother place in the family scene.

topics.headline: present brother pointed out
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Benjamin as physically present and individually identified, not merely referenced.

words.gloss_range: singular possessed kinship term: my brother, not a generic sibling category
words.prose: {{ar:أَخِي}} ({{tr:akhī}}) completes the second disclosure as my brother: the first-person suffix makes the kinship definite, personal, and Yusuf own public claim, not the brothers claim over him. The form narrows the scene from the wider brothers field to one singular possessed brother, while keeping concrete blood-kinship and loyalty pressure active; the root dispute stays a morphological note and does not displace that local kinship sense. Its Surah 12 echoes matter: secret sheltering of the brother in 12:69 becomes public brotherhood here, and the jealous speech of 12:8 is answered by Yusuf own relational claim.

words.gloss_range: certainty particle before a perfect verb, marking completed favor with present relevance
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) shifts the scene from identity to verified divine action. Before the perfect verb {{ar:مَنَّ}} ({{tr:manna}}), it presents the favor as completed and visible in the present scene: survival, reunion, and disclosure are now proof. It also creates the structural middle of the ayah, moving from personal disclosure to theological acknowledgment before the universal maxim; compared with the brothers oath-register certainty in 12:73, this certainty serves gratitude rather than denial.

topics.headline: completed favor made visible

words.gloss_range: completed divine bestowal in a favor-upon frame; reproachful branches are not selected locally

Its frame with {{ar:عَلَيْنَا}} ({{tr:ʿalaynā}}) pictures grace as bestowed upon the recipients, while the subject {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) selects the genuine divine-gift branch and blocks the reproachful human reminding branch. The root also lets provision and gift pressure remain concrete, and the favor statement is later generalized through the reward language at word 26; Yusuf names it in 12:90 and the brothers acknowledge divine preference in 12:91.
words.root_gloss_range: bestowing favor, conferring benefit, manna/provision, and also reproachful reminding; locally genuine divine favor

topics.headline: pronoun of the matter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the coming conditional is staged as a solemn matter, not an afterthought.

topics.headline: certainty moves to principle

topics.reason: Rows connect this inna to the ayah three asseverative peaks.

words.gloss_range: conditional whoever opening a universal protasis under which two verbs are governed
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) opens the personal story into whoever. Under the canonical conditional reading it governs both following jussive verbs, making guarding and patience one protasis rather than a description of Yusuf alone. The accepted indicative variant can make it sound more relative, the one who habitually guards, but the local jussive frame keeps the maxim as an open conditional rule.

topics.headline: whoever opens the maxim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Yusuf story being generalized without naming a restricted class.
topics.reason: The particle introduces an open conditional clause and governs the following jussive sequence.

topics.headline: variant relative force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the variant shifts nuance toward habitual characterization without displacing the canonical conditional grammar.
topics.reason: The row is valid reading contrast, but the local QAC parse is conditional particle with jussive verbs.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII jussive self-guarding under the conditional; accepted indicative reading shifts force to habitual description
words.prose: {{ar:يَتَّقِ}} ({{tr:yattaqi}}) is the first condition: a jussive Form VIII verb under {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}), so the person is not merely protected but actively takes a guarding posture. The root shield-image makes taqwā here active self-protection and ethical vigilance, while the accepted indicative reading only narrows the contrast toward habitual guarding. Because {{ar:وَيَصْبِرْ}} ({{tr:wa-yaṣbir}}) shares the same conditional frame, guarding is inseparable from endurance, and 12:57 already prepares this reward-for-taqwā logic within the surah.
words.root_gloss_range: guarding, shielding, protection, and God-conscious self-protection; locally reflexive ethical guarding

topics.headline: conditional jussive guarding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices taqwā as a condition grammatically dependent on whoever, not a label pasted onto Yusuf alone.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as Form VIII imperfect jussive after the conditional particle.

topics.headline: active self-protection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the root as shielding and the Form VIII as self-involving agency rather than mere fear.
topics.reason: Root evidence supports guarding/protection, and the Form VIII morphology makes the subject participate in that protection.

topics.headline: taqwā joined to patience and reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first condition tied both to patience and to the reward field that closes the maxim.
topics.reason: Rows link w-q-y with ṣ-b-r and ajr, especially 12:57 and the local coordinated verb pair.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that makes guarding and patience co-conditions
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the small hinge that makes the two virtues a compound condition. It joins {{ar:يَتَّقِ}} ({{tr:yattaqi}}) and {{ar:يَصْبِرْ}} ({{tr:yaṣbir}}) under the same {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}), so the promise is not attached to either quality alone. The conjunction makes vigilance and endurance equal pillars of the protasis.

topics.headline: guarding and patience joined
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the maxim requires the two conditions together, not in sequence and not as alternatives.
topics.reason: The conjunction joins two jussive verbs under one conditional particle.

words.gloss_range: jussive endurance paired with guarding as the second condition
words.prose: {{ar:يَصْبِرْ}} ({{tr:yaṣbir}}) completes the condition in the same jussive frame as {{ar:يَتَّقِ}} ({{tr:yattaqi}}). Its root image of binding and restraining makes patience active self-holding under pressure, not passive waiting. Within Surah 12 it echoes Jacob beautiful patience in 12:18 and 12:83, and across the promise formula it meets 11:115, where patience is tied to the same non-wasting reward guarantee.
words.root_gloss_range: binding, restraining, enduring, and holding firm; locally active patience under pressure

topics.headline: equal second condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices patience as a grammatically equal co-condition, not a later explanation.
topics.reason: The verb is jussive under the same conditional governance and matches the first verb in person and mood.

topics.headline: patience as restraint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels ṣabr as holding the self together under pressure.
topics.reason: Root evidence supports binding, confining, and restraining as the image behind endurance.

topics.headline: patience vindicated in the story
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Yusuf maxim abstracting the family patience arc and linking it to non-wasted reward.
topics.reason: Rows cite 12:18, 12:83, 11:115, and local reward-formula links.

words.gloss_range: consequence particle marking the apodosis after the conditional protasis
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns the human-side condition into the divine-side result. It is the consequence marker of the apodosis, so the move from whoever guards and endures to God does not waste is grammatically required, not a loose reflection. Joined with the following {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), it makes the result both logically linked and emphatically asserted.

topics.headline: condition reaches consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the maxim crossing from human conditions into guaranteed divine consequence.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as conjunction fa, and attachment identifies the result clause after the conditional protasis.

words.gloss_range: emphatic inna opening the asserted result clause after the consequence particle
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) reinforces the result clause after the consequence particle. It governs {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) and asserts the predicate {{ar:لَا يُضِيعُ}} ({{tr:lā yuḍīʿu}}), so the apodosis is both the answer to the condition and a stand-alone certainty. As the ayah third {{tr:inna}} peak, it lands certainty on the divine guarantee.

topics.headline: emphatic result clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the outcome of the condition is grammatically reinforced, not merely stated.
topics.reason: Inna governs the divine name and introduces the predicate of the apodosis.

words.gloss_range: accusative divine name under inna as guarantor of non-wasting
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) repeats the divine name, now accusative under {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) and semantically the subject of the non-wasting predicate. The case shift from {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) to {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) tracks a role shift: God as giver of favor becomes God as guarantor of reward. The repetition binds grace and justice under one actor.
words.root_gloss_range: the uniquely definite divine name; locally the same divine actor now appears in the guarantee clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nominative divine name as favor agent

topics.headline: same God as reward guarantor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the God who bestowed favor is also the one who guarantees reward will not be wasted.
topics.reason: The divine name is accusative under inna but remains the semantic subject of the predicate.

words.gloss_range: general negation before an imperfect verb, denying every wasting failure-mode
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) frames the promise by denying the failure-mode: God does not waste. With the imperfect verb that follows, the negation has general force rather than describing one past incident. The maxim therefore gives assurance by blocking every form of loss, neglect, or squandering of the reward.

topics.headline: does-not-waste guarantee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promise is stronger than a positive reward statement because it denies the feared loss itself.
topics.reason: Lā negates an imperfect verb and begins the recognized non-wasting reward formula.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect causing-to-be-lost, negated as an enduring divine guarantee
words.prose: {{ar:يُضِيعُ}} ({{tr:yuḍīʿu}}) selects the Form IV causative: causing something to be lost, wasted, or neglected. The grammar places God where a waster could stand and then denies that action, so the reward is not merely left intact but protected from divine squandering. The rare root is heavily concentrated in this non-wasting promise form, and 12:56 already voiced the same guarantee in the divine narrator voice before Yusuf speaks it here; cross-surah parallels include 11:115 and 9:120.
words.root_gloss_range: loss, waste, neglect, and causing loss; locally the causative wasting sense is explicitly denied of God

topics.headline: caused loss explicitly denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb denies causative wasting, not just passive loss.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as Form IV imperfect negated by lā with reward as object.

topics.headline: non-wasting formula signature
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Yusuf personal testimony using a recognized Quranic promise formula.
topics.reason: Rows cite the rare-root distribution and exact formula echoes in 12:56, 11:115, 9:120, and 18:30.

words.gloss_range: accusative construct reward as the protected object of non-wasting
words.prose: {{ar:أَجْرَ}} ({{tr:ajra}}) supplies the object that {{ar:لَا يُضِيعُ}} ({{tr:lā yuḍīʿu}}) protects: the reward is the thing not allowed to be lost. As an accusative construct, it is not an indefinite reward but the specified recompense of {{ar:ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ}} ({{tr:al-muḥsinīn}}), readable as the reward earned by them or owed to them within the construct relation. Its wage-and-compensation field makes the promise feel like accountable recompense, and its echoes with 12:56 and 12:57 bring the surah reward theology into Yusuf closing maxim.
words.root_gloss_range: wage, recompense, compensation, and reward; locally a specified recompense bound to the excellence-doers

topics.headline: reward as direct object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reward is grammatically the preserved object, not abstract background.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative object of the negated Form IV verb and governs the following genitive in construct.

topics.headline: recompense as accountable value
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the reward as payable compensation that must not be misplaced, not an undefined good feeling.
topics.reason: Lexical evidence supports wage, recompense, and compensation senses, narrowed locally to divine reward.

topics.headline: reward vocabulary returns at climax
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Yusuf speech returning to the reward promises of 12:56 and 12:57 and to wider non-wasting formulas.
topics.reason: Rows cite 12:56, 12:57, 9:120, and 3:195 as concrete formula links.

words.gloss_range: definite plural active participle: the excellence-doers whose reward is guaranteed
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ}} ({{tr:al-muḥsinīn}}) closes the ayah on a definite plural ethical class. The genitive tail defines whose reward is being protected, while the Form IV active participle names people who produce excellence, not merely people who possess a static quality. Because Yusuf has shown guarding, patience, and generous treatment, the final word turns his story into the category that explains the outcome; earlier descriptions of him as among the doers of excellence in 12:36 and 12:78 now become the closing promise category, and the same excellence-after-trial class appears in the Ibrahim trial reward scene at 37:105.
words.root_gloss_range: beauty, goodness, excellence, and doing well; locally active producers of excellence

topics.headline: reward defined by excellence-doers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promise has a defined class at its endpoint, not an unlimited generic human scope.
topics.reason: The word is definite plural genitive governed by the construct reward noun.

topics.headline: producers of excellence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees iḥsān as enacted excellence, rooted in making good and beautiful, not passive goodness.
topics.reason: The word is a Form IV active participle and root evidence supports beauty/goodness/excellence.

topics.headline: story resolves as ethical maxim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word recast Yusuf disclosure as a universal category of excellence after trial.
topics.reason: Rows cite same-surah labels in 12:36 and 12:78 and broader reward-trial parallels including 37:105.
